5.eng: The divine pattern of families teaches us of our Father’s love and our relationship to Him. In fact, “our relationship to God … [is] explained in terms of the family.” Holy scriptures also teach us in terms of the family. The New Testament begins with a young family and a baby born in Bethlehem. The Book of Mormon begins with a family’s journey of faith, and the Old Testament teaches how the Creation was not complete until God had organized a family. It is often through families, despite all their imperfections, that our Father teaches us about His love.

5.spa: El modelo divino de las familias nos enseña acerca del amor de nuestro Padre y de nuestra relación con Él. De hecho, “nuestra relación con Dios […] se [explica] en términos de la familia”. Las Santas Escrituras también nos enseñan en términos de la familia. El Nuevo Testamento comienza con una familia joven y un bebé nacido en Belén. El Libro de Mormón comienza con el trayecto de fe de una familia y el Antiguo Testamento nos enseña cómo la Creación no estuvo completa hasta que Dios organizó una familia. A menudo es por medio de la familia, a pesar de todas sus imperfecciones, que nuestro Padre nos enseña acerca de Su amor.

6.eng: While at a Church meeting last year, I received an impression to do what the teacher was doing. So, in a text, I asked my wife to find a baby picture of each of our children. When I got home, we sat down and showed my kids their pictures. I told them that there are no words to fully express the love we felt when they were born, including the day each picture was taken. 8.eng: I referenced my children, but for you it might be a special love for siblings, parents, spouse, aunts, uncles, a grandparent you never met before. Or maybe all that is there is a desire for a family or for healthy family-like relationships. Families evidence a divine and eternal pattern, connecting us to our Eternal Father and to His eternal family. Even when a loving family is not part of our earthly experience, knowing that our Heavenly Father loves us can provide power, peace, and comfort, especially as we remember the eternal blessings that await all who make and keep sacred covenants—including all the blessings of an eternal family.

8.spa: Me he referido a mis hijos, pero para ustedes podría tratarse de un amor especial por hermanos, padres, cónyuge, tías, tíos, un abuelo al que nunca han conocido. O tal vez todo lo que haya es el deseo de tener una familia o de mantener relaciones cercanas saludables. Las familias son la evidencia de un modelo divino y eterno que nos conecta con nuestro Padre Eterno y con Su familia eterna. Aun si una familia amorosa no forma parte de nuestra experiencia terrenal, el saber que nuestro Padre Celestial nos ama puede brindar poder, paz y consuelo, especialmente al recordar las bendiciones eternas que esperan a todos los que hacen y guardan convenios sagrados, que incluyen todas las bendiciones de una familia eterna.

9.eng: As I bear witness of the eternal depth and nature of our Father’s love, I also offer this warning: Beware of the adversary’s deceitful lie that twists this precious truth. He tries to deceive God’s children into believing that because God loves us, we can be saved regardless of our pride, regardless of our rebellion, regardless of our sins, and regardless of our rejection of His Son and His Son’s servants. Receiving Christ through priesthood ordinances and covenants, and then being faithful to those covenants, is the only way for us to fully understand His love and the only way to exaltation.

12.eng: Second, when we understand God’s love for us and for the rest of His children, we become immune to the divisive and misleading labels of our fallen world, both the labels that people try to put on us and the labels the world tries to put on others. We see ourselves and all of God’s children as beloved and divine. We become quick to repent, slow to judge, and ever hopeful that the best is yet before us. We are forever willing to love and to make sure that no one is ever sitting, standing, or walking alone.

12.spa: En segundo lugar, cuando comprendemos el amor de Dios por nosotros y por el resto de Sus hijos, nos volvemos inmunes a las etiquetas de nuestro mundo caído que buscan dividirnos o engañarnos, tanto las etiquetas que las personas tratan de ponernos a nosotros como aquellas que el mundo trata de poner a los demás. 14.eng: God’s love is real, and Jesus Christ is evidence of that love. To fulfill His divine responsibility to help His Father’s children, He conquered sin and the grave. While still a mortal, He taught us to pray to “our Father.” Not just His Father, not someone else’s father, but our Father—a loving Heavenly Father who gives better gifts to His children than any other earthly father gives to his. Jesus Christ, through His premortal, mortal, and current ministry, points us to eternal life and personifies our Father’s deep, abiding, and eternal love.

Mientras aún era un Ser mortal, Él nos enseñó a orar a “nuestro Padre”. No se trata solo de Su Padre, ni del padre de otra persona, sino de nuestro Padre, un Padre Celestial amoroso que da a Sus hijos dádivas mejores que las que cualquier padre terrenal da a los suyos. Jesucristo, a través de Su ministerio preterrenal, terrenal y actual, nos guía a la vida eterna y personifica el amor profundo, duradero y eterno de nuestro Padre.

16.eng: What I witness before you today first came by way of the Holy Spirit when I was a young boy riding from Nuku‘alofa to my home village of Mu‘a.
